title: Nine Riders' Failure to Use 15Five and Set OKR Goals in One Ring Search
subtitle: Documents demonstrate inappropriate behavior at Mordor, Inc was pervasive
text:
Subject: Non-Compliance Issue:

To: Senior Management, Compliance Department, HR Department Date: April 36th, The Third Age

Dear Colleagues,

I am writing to bring to your attention a critical issue of non-compliance regarding the Nine Riders' failure to use 15Five and properly set Objectives and Key Results (OKR) goals in relation to the One Ring search. As a cornerstone of our organization's performance management strategy, adherence to these practices is essential to ensure that we maintain transparency, accountability, and, in the darkness, bind them to success.

Summary of the Issue:

The Nine Riders, including the Witch King of Angmar, have consistently neglected to follow our organization's performance management guidelines, as evidenced by the following:

• Failure to utilize the 15Five platform for weekly check-ins, updates, and goal tracking.

• Lack of clearly defined and measurable OKR goals related to the One Ring search. The following incident, as reported from observation of “the weathertop papers” Makes clear the abysmal failure:

Immediately, though everything else remained as before, dim and dark, the shapes became terribly clear. He was able to see beneath their black wrappings. There were five tall figures: two standing on the lip of the dell, three advancing. In their white faces burned keen and merciless eyes; under their mantles were long grey robes; upon their grey hairs were helms of silver; in their haggard hands were swords of steel.

Their eyes fell on him and pierced him, as they rushed towards him. Desperate, he drew his own sword, and it seemed to him that it flickered red, as if it was a firebrand. Two of the figures halted. The third was taller than the others: his hair was long and gleaming and on his helm was a crown. In one hand he held a long sword, and in the other a knife; both the knife and the hand that held it glowed with a pale light. He sprang forward and bore down on Frodo.

• Even with 4 individual wraith associates and senior wraith leadership in attendance, within mere feet of a hobbit brazenly wearing the one ring, none of the team reclaimed the ring. Accidents happen, however a disappointment is the absence of updated weekly key results to reflect this “close call.” Not a single “high five” was offered before or after this “near ring” event.

• Inadequate collaboration and communication inefficiencies with quintuplicated efforts.

If these issue related to continuous performance improvement best practices remain, Mordor might fade, as the high elves did before in their vanity.

We face reduced visibility into the progress and attitudes faced by the Nazgul Associates in One Ring search— including the bitter irony of invisibility itself being a core feature of the One Ring Product.

• Misalignment of goals and priorities between the Nine Riders and Isengardian, Orcish, Balrogian, Goblin, or giant spider (GS) teams. This has led to inefficiencies and real conflicts.

• Decreased accountability among 9/9 Riders, impacting overall performance and limiting go-to-mordor execution in search.

• An casual-about-performance-metrics culture that could spread to other teams and undermine our organization's dominance-related performance goals.

Recommended Actions:

To resolve this issue and ensure compliance with our organization's performance improvement practices, we recommend the following actions:

• Provide mandatory training for the Nine Riders on the proper use of the 15Five platform and the importance of regular check-ins.

• Schedule a dedicated workshop to assist the Nine Riders in setting clear, measurable, and achievable OKR goals related to the One Ring search:

• Objective: find the ring (BHAG)

• As measured by:

• 75% of knives in the dark finding their intended target

• 80% of wraiths in the proximity of a ring of power grabbing it next time

• Mandatory an documented review of the excellent 15Five training content:

• Assign a performance management liaison from HR or senior management to work closely with the Nine Riders, providing support and guidance in aligning their goals and reporting their progress.

• Monitor and evaluate the Nine Riders' compliance with performance management practices and address any cultural issues through regular peer reinforcement of culturally appropriate workplace behaviors.

Next Steps:

We request that the relevant departments coordinate to implement the recommended actions and ensure that the Nine Riders are fully compliant with our organization's performance management practices. An update on the progress of these actions should be provided to senior management within the next four weeks.

Thank you for your attention to this critical issue. Your collaboration and commitment to upholding our performance management standards are vital to our organization's success in the One Ring search and beyond. Of note, 15Five has a partnership with Mindbloom, and although the dissociative effects of oral Ketamine on those already living in the littoral zone between life and death being unclear, a relentless focus on wraith-wellness is part of the part forward.

Sincerely,

Grima Wormtongue,

VP, Wraith Reasources

Mordor, Inc

@wormtongue on Twitter
